desc:
⭐ Welcome to Swing Tower! 

Can you use your rope to reach the top without falling?

How to Play:
- 🚀 Double Jump to launch your grapple rope and swing like a pro!
- 🤾‍♂️ DON'T FALL! If you slip, you might fall to the bottom!
- 💵 Buy AWESOME ropes skins to look sick while you swing.
- 🌎 Get to the top to unlock more Worlds!

❤️ LIKE, FAVORITE, AND JOIN OUR GROUP FOR 1 FREE CHECKPOINT AND UPDATES!
